missionHeart: Boring browser-local mutation: bounded admission, provider cancellation, same-origin coordination, inspectable receipts, and honest storage non-claims.
riskSelected: The storage posture receipt existed, but consumers still had to enter through a root module that statically loaded the full BrowserRT facade; package source budget was also near its guard.
changes: Root public API now lazy-imports the full BrowserRT facade only in boot().
browserrt/browser-storage-posture typed subpath added for direct posture/policy imports.
browser-storage-posture exports the receipt format and admission-policy builder.
Installed package smoke proves the subpath receipt and absence of full boot facade on that subpath.
Package/public audits now gate the lazy root and typed subpath.

sourceCompaction.method: removed blank-only source lines after adding the typed subpath

nextRecommendedSlice: Start replacing package src/*.mjs with a generated/reachable publish file list or add more subpaths, then move demo/support surfaces behind explicit non-root imports.
nonClaims: No production readiness or publication claim.
Lazy root import reduces initial dependency load but does not yet remove the full facade from the package tarball.
Subpath smoke is Node/package evidence, not browser matrix proof.
